instruction: For the academicpages template in ~/Code/Website/academicpages.github.io/_config.yml, I need to set my GitHub username. Please change the author github field to "drchen-research" and the repository field to "drchen-research/drchen-research.github.io".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task updates GitHub-related fields: author.github and repository. One nested, one top-level field. Uses existing check_json metric.
